messages:
Marta V: Quick follow-up to the geo gating RFC 1 — proposing a tiny edge gate that enforces tenant residency allowlists and falls back deterministically.
Sam K: Runtime split? edge vs control plane vs fallback service?
Marta V: Edge (Envoy filter) does fast decision from a local cache; control plane holds canonical policies and versions; fallback is a hardened proxy that can mask PII or reject.
Raj P: Edge cache staleness is my main worry. How tolerant are we of short windows of inconsistency?
Marta V: Options: 1) Sync consult every request (high tail). 2) Cache w/ short TTL (30s) + versioned header + async audit. 3) Hybrid: unknown version triggers consult but bounded by CB. Recommend (3).
Sam K: How to stop clients spoofing region hints?
Marta V: Edge overwrites client hints with canonical X-Region-Decision; clients can only suggest.
Elaine (Legal): Need audit trail: who changed policy, change reason, timestamp. Also define error codes for residency denies and retention window for logs.
Sam K: Metrics: per-tenant gate hits, fallback rates, policy-stale events, circuit trips. Alert on rising stale-deny.
Marta V: Action items: Sam prototype Envoy filter (1w spike), Raj threat model for fallback, infra to expose policy API w/ audit hooks, Elaine to specify audit fields/retention.
infra-bot: Spike cluster scheduled 2024-10-03T02:00Z (3h window).
Sam K: I'll start the spike branch and post results here.
Marta V: Keeping it small lets us iterate while honoring legal constraints. :white_check_mark:
